title: Polarized thermal emission from dust in a galaxy at redshift 2.6
question: Is there a large-scale ordered magnetic field in a z=2.6 lensed starburst galaxy, as traced by polarized dust emission?

what.value: Lens model parameters (SIE+shear) and CO(4-3) disk model (Rmax, Vmax, tilt, inclination)

evidence.quote: Extended Data Table 1 summarises the best-fit lens model parameters from$^5$.

what.value: Molecular gas mass, velocity dispersion and disk height from CO

evidence.quote: The total molecular mass is estimated from the CO luminosity$^5$ as $M_{\rm{H_{2}}} = (7.5\pm0.1)\times10^{10}$ M$_{\odot}$

recipe.method: ALMA pipeline plus polarization calibration; tclean on all Stokes with common beam

recipe.goal: Measure polarization fraction and B-field angle
recipe.method: Debiased P from mean Q,U,I for pixels with P/sigma_P>=3; chi_B = 0.5 arctan(U/Q)+pi/2; mean from independent beams

recipe.goal: Constrain source-plane B-field orientation via lens simulation
recipe.method: Lens source-plane Gaussian disk with constant chi_B and P=1%, lensed with SIE+shear, simulated with simobserve, cleaned like data; compare Stokes U detection
key_parameters: 801x801 grid, 0.01'' pixel; pwv 0.6 mm; antenna configuration 2 (Cycle 8)
assumptions: Constant polarization fraction of unity/1% and constant B orientation in source plane; continuum matches CO morphology

recipe.method: B_eq = sqrt(4 pi rho) sigma_v with rho from H2 mass over disk volume
key_parameters: r=2647 pc, h<=600 pc, M_H2=7.5e10 Msun, sigma_v=73 km/s
assumptions: Equipartition of turbulent kinetic and magnetic energy

recipe.method: Ordering timescale and dynamo number following Arshakian et al.

evidence.quote: We measure an image plane integrated flux density of $I=62$ mJy
orientated $\chi_{\rm B} =5^{+5}_{-10}$ degrees east of north
the ordering timescale is estimated to be in the range of $\tilde{t} \approx 0.4$–$18$ Gyr

not_stated_but_needed: Image size and cell size for tclean
Polarization calibration script details and polarization calibrator model
Exact sensitivity-weighted selection of pixels for averages
score_reason: Data public and main steps described, but several imaging settings and the polarization script are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric results (P, chi_B) are reproducible via CASA polarization imaging.
